profile.campus: MERLIN Bilbao-Arasur Data Center Campus, Rivabellosa, Álava
profile.address: Supermanzana 6, Plataforma Logística Arasur, Avenida Ribera Baja S/N, 01213 Rivabellosa, Álava, Spain
profile.reading: This is the second building of MERLIN Properties Bilbao-Arasur Data Center Campus, at Supermanzana 6, Plataforma Logistica Arasur, Avenida Ribera Baja S/N, in Rivabellosa, Alava, in Spains Basque Country, under construction as of September 2025. MERLIN Properties, a listed Spanish real estate investment trust (SOCIMI), is developing the site under its MERLIN Edged data center brand; this second building is rated at 48 megawatts of capacity and is described by the company as part of an initial 118 megawatt phase of the campus, sited in what MERLIN calls one of Europes most strategic digital hubs given its ultra fast connections to North America and Northern Europe, and is being built explicitly for next generation AI workloads. The building is designed for a power usage effectiveness of 1.15 and a water usage effectiveness of 0.0 through waterless cooling technology, running on 100 percent renewable energy. The full Arasur campus is planned to reach 300 megawatts of IT power capacity across three development phases once complete, which MERLIN says would make it Spains largest data center campus, powered in part by an on site photovoltaic installation of more than 100 megawatts. MERLIN Properties was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Madrid, listed on Spains IBEX 35 stock index, with total assets reported at about 12.63 billion euros in 2025. The company built its Iberian commercial real estate portfolio partly through the 2015 acquisition of Testa and the 2016 purchase of Metrovacesas commercial assets, and today operates across office, shopping center, logistics, and, through its MERLIN Edged brand including this Arasur campus, data center segments. Spanish trade press has reported that MERLIN plans a large scale investment program at Arasur expected to mobilize more than 1.7 billion euros across the campus overall growth, describing the site as hyperscale infrastructure built for progressive expansion, with additional data center buildings planned at the campus beyond this second one in the years following its September 2025 construction update.
